method: Static checks by reading the concept's own source plus live headless-browser verification over http against the real shared modules.

static_checks.check: virtualization present: PMManagers2.virtualList on #/all with rowHeight 64 and data-window updates
no scope selectors (Global/Project/Goal/Host), no inheritance, no profiles/sync UI
no emoji; icons only via PMIcons
no left accent bars; no parchment/brass/gears/sepia/fantasy/book ornament; colors only via var(--token)
reduced motion: [data-reduced-motion=1] kills page-turn and skeleton animations (pm-shell.css + concept CSS)
search rows carry data-rid and .pm2-r-title; routing via PMSearch2.byRid only
test hooks present: data-test=search-input/search-results/back/close/home/all/copy/vlist, data-route on root view, data-manager on every manager section, data-window on vlist host

live_checks.check: home renders: 14 rail tabs, 12 chapter cards, notices, utilities
search 'rate limit': grouped dropdown (Settings/Objects), duplicate 'Rate Limits' rows with distinct paths
select result: routes to #/mgr/providers/claude-oauth?sec=limits, .pm2-locate on roster item, data-manager=providers
browser Back: #/q/rate%20limit with query text restored and dropdown reopened with same 7 results
all 42 manager routes: [data-manager], [data-test=back], [data-test=breadcrumb] present; data-route correct
#/all: data-window 25:46:828 at scrollTop 2000; count '828 rows'; synthetic toggle adds 2000 (2828 total)
copy flow: source -> categories -> preview counts (add/replace/unchanged/unavailable/conflict) -> apply -> step 4 with rollback
squeezed tier: rail hidden, roster pushes (hidden when object open), Back names roster level
offline scenario: critical banner on home, Doctor last-known-health banner
providers detail tabs render (overview/accounts/models/install/limits/logs); deferred shells single per owner

known_limitations: Manager-local fixture rows are demo values persisted under pm.tt9.fx; they are not inventory rows by design.
Wide-tier margin pane is informational only (location, attention, receipts).
Concept is a prototype; no canonical Plans/catalog changes.
